fixtures.name: legacy-tls
fixtures.positive: TLS 1.0 negotiation
fixtures.negative: TLS 1.2 and TLS 1.3 negotiation
fixtures.false_positive_notes: A negotiated legacy protocol proves configuration posture, not a historical exploit.
fixtures.false_negative_notes: A failed handshake may be inconclusive when the client or provider disables TLS 1.0.

fixtures.name: legacy11-tls
fixtures.positive: TLS 1.1 negotiation
fixtures.negative: TLS 1.2 and TLS 1.3 negotiation
fixtures.false_positive_notes: A negotiated legacy protocol proves configuration posture, not a historical exploit.
fixtures.false_negative_notes: A failed handshake may be inconclusive when the client or provider disables TLS 1.1.

fixtures.name: weak-tls
fixtures.positive: TLS 1.2 CBC negotiation
fixtures.negative: TLS 1.3 negotiation
fixtures.false_positive_notes: CBC support is a prerequisite signal and does not confirm Lucky13 exploitation.
fixtures.false_negative_notes: Provider policy can suppress a CBC result even when another client would negotiate it.

fixtures.name: modern-tls
fixtures.positive: TLS 1.3 negotiation
fixtures.negative: TLS 1.2 negotiation
fixtures.false_positive_notes: TLS 1.3 support is a protocol posture observation only.
fixtures.false_negative_notes: A TLS 1.3 failure may reflect client crypto-provider constraints.

fixtures.name: breach-tls
fixtures.positive: Synthetic HTTPS reflection with compression prerequisites
fixtures.negative: modern-tls HTTPS response without compression or sensitive reflection
fixtures.false_positive_notes: The fixture intentionally combines compression, reflection, and cookie markers; the result is potential exposure, not demonstrated exploitation.
fixtures.false_negative_notes: The heuristic reads the controlled GET responses only and cannot model application routing, browser behavior, or secret entropy.

fixtures.name: modern-tls-breach
fixtures.positive: No BREACH prerequisites observed
fixtures.negative: breach-tls synthetic reflection fixture
fixtures.false_positive_notes: A clean modern fixture does not prove every application route is safe.
fixtures.false_negative_notes: Only GET / is tested and no real application secrets are accessed.

fixtures.name: legacy-tls-beast
fixtures.positive: TLS 1.0 CBC configuration detected by BEAST probe
fixtures.negative: modern-tls TLS 1.3 configuration
fixtures.false_positive_notes: The result confirms the published TLS 1.0 CBC posture signal, not a browser exploit against an application.
fixtures.false_negative_notes: Provider cipher policy and client crypto support can prevent the TLS 1.0 probe from completing.

fixtures.name: modern-tls-beast
fixtures.positive: No TLS 1.0 or SSL 3.0 CBC posture
fixtures.negative: legacy-tls TLS 1.0 CBC configuration
fixtures.false_positive_notes: A clean endpoint does not prove every backend in a load-balanced fleet is clean.
fixtures.false_negative_notes: Only the configured endpoint and resolved address are tested.

fixtures.name: sweet32-tls
fixtures.positive: Synthetic ServerHello responses for the registered 3DES wire IDs
fixtures.negative: Any non-3DES cipher probe receives a TLS alert
fixtures.false_positive_notes: This fixture validates wire-level 3DES classification only; it does not implement a vulnerable TLS stack or demonstrate a birthday attack.
fixtures.false_negative_notes: The synthetic responder does not model certificate exchange, protocol negotiation, or server implementation behavior.

fixtures.name: crime-tls
fixtures.positive: Synthetic ServerHello negotiates DEFLATE TLS compression
fixtures.negative: Synthetic ServerHello negotiates the null compression method
fixtures.false_positive_notes: This fixture validates TLS compression classification only; it does not execute a CRIME secret-recovery attack.
fixtures.false_negative_notes: The synthetic responder does not model a complete TLS stack or application-layer compression.

fixtures.name: crime-patched-tls
fixtures.positive: Synthetic ServerHello negotiates the null compression method
fixtures.negative: Synthetic ServerHello negotiates DEFLATE TLS compression
fixtures.false_positive_notes: A clean compression negotiation does not prove HTTP/2 or application-layer compression safety.
fixtures.false_negative_notes: Only the TLS compression negotiation path is exercised.

fixtures.name: heartbleed-tls
fixtures.positive: Synthetic ServerHello accepts heartbeat and echoes an oversized payload
fixtures.negative: Synthetic ServerHello without heartbeat support
fixtures.false_positive_notes: The fixture validates heartbeat response classification only; it is not a vulnerable OpenSSL implementation.
fixtures.false_negative_notes: The responder does not model TLS key material, memory layout, or a complete handshake.

fixtures.name: heartbleed-patched-tls
fixtures.positive: Synthetic ServerHello omits heartbeat support
fixtures.negative: Synthetic ServerHello accepts heartbeat and echoes an oversized payload
fixtures.false_positive_notes: A server that rejects heartbeat is clean for this probe path only.
fixtures.false_negative_notes: The fixture cannot establish whether a real implementation mishandles malformed heartbeat messages.

fixtures.name: ccs-tls
fixtures.positive: Synthetic ServerHello accepts the premature ChangeCipherSpec record
fixtures.negative: Synthetic ServerHello responds to the premature record with an alert
fixtures.false_positive_notes: The fixture validates early CCS response classification only; it is not a vulnerable OpenSSL implementation.
fixtures.false_negative_notes: The responder does not model key scheduling or a complete TLS handshake.

fixtures.name: ccs-patched-tls
fixtures.positive: Synthetic ServerHello rejects the premature ChangeCipherSpec record
fixtures.negative: Synthetic ServerHello accepts the premature record
fixtures.false_positive_notes: A clean early-CCS response does not cover unrelated TLS state-machine flaws.
fixtures.false_negative_notes: Only the premature CCS response path is exercised.

fixtures.name: ticketbleed-tls
fixtures.positive: Synthetic NewSessionTicket flow echoes the marker with 16 extra bytes
fixtures.negative: Synthetic NewSessionTicket flow echoes only the marker
fixtures.false_positive_notes: The fixture validates session-ID leak classification only; it is not an F5 BIG-IP implementation.
fixtures.false_negative_notes: The responder does not model TLS ticket encryption or allocator state.

fixtures.name: ticketbleed-patched-tls
fixtures.positive: Synthetic NewSessionTicket flow echoes only the marker
fixtures.negative: Synthetic NewSessionTicket flow echoes the marker with extra bytes
fixtures.false_positive_notes: A clean marker echo does not cover unrelated session-ticket flaws.
fixtures.false_negative_notes: Only the resumed ServerHello session-ID path is exercised.

fixtures.name: robot-tls
fixtures.positive: Synthetic RSA handshake returns stable distinct alert codes per invalid vector
fixtures.negative: Synthetic RSA handshake returns one alert code for every invalid vector
fixtures.false_positive_notes: The fixture validates alert-code oracle classification only; it is not a vulnerable RSA TLS implementation.
fixtures.false_negative_notes: The responder does not perform RSA decryption or model timing behavior.

fixtures.name: robot-patched-tls
fixtures.positive: Synthetic RSA handshake returns one alert code for every invalid vector
fixtures.negative: Synthetic RSA handshake returns stable distinct alert codes per invalid vector
fixtures.false_positive_notes: A uniform alert response does not cover timing-only or application-level oracles.
fixtures.false_negative_notes: Only the alert-code response path is exercised.

fixtures.name: fallback-tls
fixtures.positive: Synthetic ServerHello accepts a TLS_FALLBACK_SCSV ClientHello
fixtures.negative: Synthetic ServerHello accepts the same fallback without rejecting SCSV
fixtures.false_positive_notes: The fixture validates downgrade-alert classification only; it does not execute a POODLE downgrade or attack.
fixtures.false_negative_notes: The responder does not model a complete TLS implementation or protocol-specific downgrade state.

fixtures.name: fallback-patched-tls
fixtures.positive: Synthetic ServerHello rejects TLS_FALLBACK_SCSV with alert 0x56
fixtures.negative: Synthetic ServerHello accepts a fallback ClientHello
fixtures.false_positive_notes: A correct SCSV alert proves only this negotiation path is protected.
fixtures.false_negative_notes: Only the TLS_FALLBACK_SCSV response is exercised; other downgrade controls require separate handshakes.

fixtures.name: weak-ciphers-tls
fixtures.positive: Synthetic ServerHello responses for registered RC4, NULL, RSA_EXPORT, and DH_EXPORT wire IDs
fixtures.negative: Any non-legacy cipher probe receives a TLS alert
fixtures.false_positive_notes: This fixture validates wire-level legacy cipher classification only; it does not implement a vulnerable TLS stack or demonstrate RC4, FREAK, or LOGJAM exploitation.
fixtures.false_negative_notes: The synthetic responder does not model certificate exchange, protocol negotiation, DH parameters, or server implementation behavior.

fixtures.name: modern-tls-weak-ciphers

fixtures.name: grease-intolerant-tls

fixtures.false_negative_notes: The fixture covers this endpoint and the four probe ClientHellos only; other extension values are not modeled.

fixtures.name: grease-tolerant-tls

fixtures.false_negative_notes: It does not cover all future reserved values or load-balanced backends.

fixtures.name: early-data-patched-tls
